about_the_game:
Add it to your wishlist, please!

Gods vs Horrors is a roguelike card auto-battler focusing on synergies, scaling, and positioning. You'll need to adapt to the choices offered and enemy compositions. Recruit and dismiss Gods, reroll your options, increase your devotion level to get access to more powerful Gods, and fight Cosmic Horrors in automated battles.

The demo features:

  • 5 mythologies (full game has 10) and over 80 playable cards

  • 2 campaigns with different enemies (full game has 7)

  • 10 relics to customize your runs (full game has 30)

  • Infinite difficulty scaling to increase the challenge

ALL DECISIONS MATTER

  • Take synergies and scaling to another level. Each roll could deliver the final piece for your build or enable a crazy change in your composition.

  • Spend your divine essence to strengthen your army now or use it to increase your devotion level and gain access to more powerful Gods later. Balancing short-term survival with late-game power is key to creating an unstoppable build.

  • Position your Gods to counter the enemy's formation and composition. Combat is automatic, easy to follow, and deterministic (no RNG). It can be sped up or slowed down as desired.

Game inspirations: Hearthstone's Battlegrounds mode, Slay the Spire, Super Auto Pets, Teamfight Tactics, Balatro, Magic the Gathering drafting.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04
  • Processor: SSE2 support
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+, Vulkan capable

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS High Sierra 10.13
  • Processor: SSE2 support
  • Graphics: Metal capable (starting at late 2012 models)
